post.caption: Meteorite crashes can turn graphite into diamond. Impact diamonds keep the shape of the graphite crystals they replaced. Russia's Popigai crater is about 35.7 million years old and about 100 kilometers across, and geologist Victor Masaitis proved its impact origin in 1971. Russian estimates put its diamonds at over 100 billion carats, but most are tiny and meant for industry, not jewelry. The first diamonds from space were found in 1888. A debated rarer form, lonsdaleite, turned up in a meteorite in 1967. Lonsdaleite is named for Dame Kathleen Lonsdale.
